name: Alt Duvenstedt (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alt Duvenstedt (a yellow wheel above a white wavy bar and reeds on green).
history: Municipal flag of Alt Duvenstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Alt Duvenstedt arms — wheel, wavy bar and reeds on green
